hero.copy: A small inn, a clear-water lagoon, and just enough time to hear what really matters again.
hero.caption: Calm water, good shade, a table set.

search.subtitle: Choose what fits your days here.

intro.copy: Between the embracing green and the inviting water, Beira D’Água is made for those who want to break the routine. Here, every room opens onto a piece of nature, every meal tastes of the coast, and every afternoon can last as long as you want.

atmosphere.copy: There’s no mandatory schedule, no early alarm clock. There’s a long shower, a book open on the porch, and the chance to do nothing — with great pleasure.
atmosphere.item2Copy: Simple, beautiful, and full of quiet.

roomsTeaser.copy: A quiet corner to wake up without a rush. A comfortable bed, natural light, and nature as company.

food.copy: Recipes that respect the ingredient and the place. Fish, seafood, the warmth of the grill, and that urge to stay a little longer after lunch.

park.copy: When it’s time to play, Little Beach takes over: water slides, a lagoon, and a whole day to laugh without watching the clock.

gallery.copy: Or come back soon. Some views feel just like home.

location.title: Where to find
location.description: Just steps from the sea, in a quiet corner of the coast.

contact.copy: Your trip starts with the first question. Talk to our team and find the perfect itinerary for your family — no commitment, with the patience of people who love what they do.

quartosPage.guideCopy: There's no such thing as a better room. There's the room that fits how you want to rest. Browse our corners and send us your preference — prices are quoted case by case.

cardapioPage.heroCopy: A coastal cuisine, made to keep up with the changing sky and a conversation that lingers.
cardapioPage.heroImageAlt: Fish served at the table by the water
cardapioPage.introCopy: We cook with what we find beautiful and fresh. The cuisine follows the season, the catch, and the mood of the day — so here you'll find a direction of flavors, not a rigid list.

littleBeachPage.heroCopy: Beira D’Água's Little Beach was made for those who like to laugh out loud, get soaked, and go back to the inn with a new story.
littleBeachPage.introCopy: Between one slide and another, there's shade, breeze, and the kind of joy that needs no caption. Choose your pace — the adventure starts with the next wave.
littleBeachPage.highlight1Copy: To run, float, slide, or just get your feet wet.
littleBeachPage.highlight2Copy: Attractions for those who want to speed up and those who prefer to take it slow.
littleBeachPage.highlight3Copy: A space designed to bring together families, friends, and lots of laughter.
